payload.research_summary: Open. The problem is known to be in co-NP but co-NP-hardness is unproved (and conjectured). Literature status: Source: Egres Open. Verified literature: Hujter, Kiss and Tóthmérész, "On the complexity of the chip-firing reachability problem", Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 145 (2017), show the reachability problem lies in co-NP for general digraphs, is polynomial even with multiple edges for Eulerian digraphs, and is decidable in polynomial time on some special cases. Björner–Lovász conjectured reachability is hard for general digraphs; whether it is co-NP-hard remains open.
